Title: Verify cannot delete current logged in user from PIM
Preconditions: User is logged in as Admin
Test Data: Emp Number of logged in user
Steps: 1. Send DELETE request to delete the employee record of the current user.
Expected Result: Request is rejected. Current user's employee record is not deleted.

Title: Verify create employee fails with existing employeeId
Steps: 1. Send POST request to create employee with existing employeeId.
Expected Result: Request is rejected with unique validation error.

Title: Verify create employee succeeds with valid data
Steps: 1. Send POST request to create employee with valid data.
Expected Result: Employee is created successfully. EmployeeAddedEvent is dispatched.

Title: Verify first name length validation (max 30)
Steps: 1. Send POST request to create employee with first name length > 30.
Expected Result: Request is rejected with length validation error.

Title: Verify cannot use same email for work and other email
Steps: 1. Send PUT request to update contact details with same email for work and other.
Expected Result: Request is rejected with error "Work Email and Other Email Cannot Be The Same".

Title: Verify contact details update fails if email exists
Steps: 1. Send PUT request to update contact details of Employee B with existing email.
Expected Result: Request is rejected with unique email validation error.

Title: Verify profile picture upload validation
Steps: 1. Send POST request to create employee with valid PNG picture.
Expected Result: Employee is created successfully and picture is uploaded.

Title: Verify job details update with invalid foreign key fails
Steps: 1. Send PUT request to update job details with invalid jobTitleId.
Expected Result: Request is rejected. Foreign key validation fails.
